import pandas as pd,numpy as np,cv2
d=pd.read_csv('out/demo_metadata.csv'); o=pd.read_csv('demo_metadata.csv')
img=cv2.imread('demo_rgb.png'); h,w=img.shape[:2]
acc=np.zeros((h,w),int); vis=img.copy(); vo=img.copy()
print(list(d.columns)==list(o.columns), len(d)==len(o), (d.iloc[:,:5]==o.iloc[:,:5]).all().all())
bad=0
for i,r in d.iterrows():
    xs=np.array(r.coords_x.split(','),float); ys=np.array(r.coords_y.split(','),float)
    pts=np.stack([xs,ys],1).astype(np.int32)
    m=np.zeros((h,w),np.uint8); cv2.fillPoly(m,[pts],1)
    n,_=cv2.connectedComponents(m)
    rect=len(np.unique(pts[:-1],axis=0))==4 and len(set(xs))<=2
    if n!=2 or rect or xs.min()!=r.xmin or ys.max()!=r.ymax: bad+=1; print('bad',i,n,rect)
    acc+=m; cv2.polylines(vis,[pts],True,(0,255,0),1)
    po=np.stack([np.array(o.coords_x[i].split(','),float),np.array(o.coords_y[i].split(','),float)],1).astype(np.int32)
    cv2.polylines(vo,[po],True,(0,0,255),1)
print('max overlap',acc.max(),'bad',bad)
cv2.imwrite('/tmp/vis.png',np.hstack([vo,vis]))
EOF
